entries.explanation: Muhammad bin Qasim ki Sindh muhim 711 mein shuru hui; Debal isi muhim mein fatah hone wali Sindh ki sahili basti thi. Muhim ka aaghaz 711 aur Sindh ki mashhoor fatah se mansoob 712 do alag marhalon ki tareekhein hain.
Sindh ki Arab fatah Muhammad bin Qasim ki qiyadat mein hui aur isay aam tor par 712 Isvi se jora jata hai. Un ki pesh-qadmi Sindh tak mehdood nahin rahi: futoohat Multan tak bhi pahunchein.
Baba Fariduddin Ganj Shakar Chishti silsilay ke mashhoor Sufi buzurg thay. Un ki wafat 1265 mein Pakpattan mein hui; yahan saal un ki wafat ka hai, paidaish ya kisi hukoomat ke aaghaz ka nahin.

Jalaluddin Firoz Khilji ne 1290 mein Delhi Sultanat ke andar Khilji khandan ki hukoomat ki bunyad rakhi. Yeh khandani daur 1320 tak chala; 1290 se 1320 poori dynasty ka arsa hai, sirf bani ki zaati hukoomat ka nahin.
Khilji khandan ki Delhi Sultanat par hukoomat 1290 mein Jalaluddin Firoz Khilji se shuru hui aur 1320 mein khatam hui. Is liye 1320 ko daur ka aakhri saal aur 1290 ko bunyad ka saal samajhna chahiye.

Attock Fort Mughal badshah Akbar ke ahd ki tameer hai aur darya-e-Sindh ke qareeb waqay hai. Tameer 1581 mein shuru hui aur 1583 mein mukammal hui; aaghaz aur takmeel ke sawalon mein isi do saala farq ko samjhein.
Chauburji Lahore ki Mughal tarz-e-tameer ki yaadgar hai, jo 1646 mein Shah Jahan ke daur mein bani. Is naam ka lafzi matlab char burj hai; naam imarat ke char numayan burjon ki nisbat se para.

Aurangzeb ke hukm par Lahore ki Badshahi Masjid ki tameer May 1671 mein shuru hui aur April 1673 mein mukammal hui. Masjid Lahore Fort ke muqabil hai; dono imaratein Lahore ke Mughal virsay ka hissa hain.

Badshahi Masjid ki takmeel 1673 mein Aurangzeb ke daur mein hui; kaam 1671 mein shuru ho chuka tha. Lahore Fort is ke samne hai, is liye masjid ke bani, tameeri muddat aur maqam ko aik hi silsilay mein jora ja sakta hai.

1757 ki Plassey ki jang mein Robert Clive British East India Company ki fauj ki qiyadat kar raha tha. Bengal ke Nawab Siraj-ud-Daula ki shikast ne Company ke siyasi asar aur Bengal mein us ke iqtidar ke liye rasta khola.

14 January 1761 ko Panipat ki teesri jang Ahmad Shah Abdali ke Afghan qiyadat wale ittihad aur Marathas ke darmiyan hui. Shah Waliullah ne is se pehle shumali Hind ki siyasi surat-e-haal par Abdali ko mudakhlat ke liye khat likha tha.

Pitt's India Act 1784 ne East India Company aur British Crown ke darmiyan dual control ka nizam banaya. Company ke kuch kaam barqarar rahe, jabke Crown ka muqarrar karda Board of Control Hindustani muamlaat aur policy ki nigrani karta tha.

Sir Syed Ahmad Khan 17 October 1817 ko Delhi mein paida hue aur 27 March 1898 ko Aligarh mein wafat pai. Unhon ne 1877 mein MAO College qayam kiya; jadeed taleem ka yeh idara 1920 mein Aligarh Muslim University bana.

Syed Ahmad Shaheed bar-e-sagheer ki Mujahideen ya Tehreek-e-Jihad ki qiyadat se mansoob hain. Woh aur Shah Ismail 1831 mein Balakot ki jang mein shaheed hue; Balakot yahan shahadat aur jang ka maqam hai.

Muahida-e-Amritsar 1846 mein British hukoomat aur Maharaja Gulab Singh ke darmiyan hua. Is mein Kashmir samait muayyan pahari ilaqon ki muntaqili ke badlay 75 lakh Nanak Shahi rupay ki adaigi ki shart rakhi gayi.

Doosri Anglo-Sikh jang 1848–1849 mein lari gayi aur Sikh afwaj ki shikast par khatam hui. March 1849 mein East India Company ne Punjab ko baqaida British India mein shamil kar liya; jang aur annexation isi silsilay ke do marhalay hain.

Murree 1853 mein British hill station ke taur par qayam hua. Punjab ke garam maidani ilaqon ke muqable mein thanday pahari maqam ko fauji aur shehri istemal ke liye taraqqi di gayi; yeh Islamabad aur Rawalpindi ke qareeb Rawalpindi Division mein hai.

10 May 1857 ko Meerut ki chhaoni se bari sipahi baghawat shuru hui aur baghi Delhi ki taraf barhay. Wahan aakhri Mughal badshah Bahadur Shah II, yani Bahadur Shah Zafar, ko apni alamat-e-qiyadat ke taur par tasleem kiya.

1857 ki muzahamat mein Rai Ahmad Khan Kharal ne Gogera ke ilaqay mein qiyadat ki. Is waqiay mein Gogera muzahamat ka aham markaz aur Ahmad Khan Kharal us ke rehnuma hain; dono naam aik hi tehreeki pas-e-manzar se jure hain.

1857 ki baghawat ke baad Government of India Act 1858 ne Company ki hukoomat khatam karke intizam seedha British Crown ko diya. Queen Victoria ka ailan 1 November 1858 ko hua; Britain mein nigrani ke liye Secretary of State for India ka ohda banaya gaya.

Bahadur Shah Zafar ko 1857 ki baghawat ke baad muqadmay ka samna karna para aur 1858 mein Rangoon jila-watan kar diya gaya. Baghawat aur jila-watni ke darmiyan aik saal ka farq hai; yeh aakhri Mughal badshah ki zindagi ke baad ke marhalay thay.

Darul Uloom Deoband 1866 mein Deoband mein qayam hua aur bar-e-sagheer ka aham deeni aur ilmi markaz bana. Muhammad Qasim Nanotvi ne doosray ulama ke saath is ki bunyad rakhne mein markazi kirdar ada kiya.

1867 mein Banaras ki muhim ne adalati aur sarkari istemal mein Urdu ki jagah Hindi lane ka mutalba kiya. Yeh Urdu-Hindi tanaza Sir Syed Ahmad Khan ke Hindu-Muslim siyasi taluqaat ke tasawwur mein aham mor sabit hua.

Sir Syed Ahmad Khan ki Ahkam-e-Ta'am-e-Ahl-e-Kitab 1868 mein shaya hui. Is kitab ka mauzu Ahl-e-Kitab ke khane se mutalliq sharai bahs hai; isay un ki taleemi tehreek ke bajaye un ki tasneefi aur mazhabi bahs ke hawalay se samjhein.

Sir Syed Ahmad Khan ne 1877 mein Aligarh mein Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental College jadeed taleem ke farogh ke liye qayam kiya. Isi college ko 1920 mein university ka darja mila aur Aligarh Muslim University bani; college aur university ke qayam ke saal alag hain.

Syed Ameer Ali ne 1877 mein Calcutta mein Central National Muhammadan Association qayam ki. Is tanzeem ka talluq Muslims ki siyasi numaindagi aur samaji islaah se tha, is liye isay sirf aik taleemi college ke taur par na samjhein.

Anjuman-i-Himayat-i-Islam 1884 mein Lahore mein Muslim taleem aur samaji islaah ke liye qayam hui. Missionary asar ke muqable mein jadeed taleem ko deeni tarbiyat ke saath jorna is ka maqsad tha; pehle sadar Khalifa Qazi Hameed-ud-Din thay.

Hassan Ali Effendi ne Sindh mein jadeed taleem ke farogh ke liye Sindh Madressatul Islam qayam kiya. Is idaray ka aaghaz 1 September 1885 ko Karachi mein hua; bani, shehar aur qayam ki tareekh aik hi taleemi waqiay ke hisay hain.

Allan Octavian Hume ne 1885 mein kai Hindustani rehnumaon ke saath Indian National Congress ki tashkeel mein aham intizami kirdar ada kiya. Siyasat ke ilawa woh parindon ke ilmi mutalay, yani ornithology, se bhi mansoob thay.

Durand Line ka sarhadi muahida 1893 mein Sir Mortimer Durand aur Amir Abdur Rahman Khan ke darmiyan hua. Afghanistan-Pakistan sarhad se mansoob is line ki aam bayan karda lambai taqreeban 2,640 km hai; 1893 muahiday ka saal hai.

Sir Syed Ahmad Khan 17 October 1817 ko Delhi mein paida hue aur 27 March 1898 ko Aligarh mein wafat pai. Un ki qabr Aligarh Muslim University ki markazi masjid ke qareeb hai; paidaish Delhi aur wafat-o-tadfeen Aligarh se juri hain.
Darul Uloom Nadwatul Ulama ka taleemi idara 1898 mein Lucknow mein qayam hua. Yeh deeni aur asri taleem ke imtizaj ke liye mashhoor hua; Lucknow is idaray ka shehar aur 1898 us ke qayam ka saal hai.

Nawab Mohsin-ul-Mulk ne 1900 mein Urdu Defence Association munazzam ki. Is anjuman ka maqsad Urdu zaban ka difa tha; tanzeem ke naam, bani aur saal ko zaban ke tahaffuz ki isi muhim ke saath jor kar samjhein.

Hafeez Jalandhari 14 January 1900 ko Jalandhar mein paida hue aur 21 December 1982 ko Lahore mein wafat pai. Pakistan ke qaumi taranay ke alfaaz unhon ne likhe, jabke dhun A. G. Chagla ki thi; alfaaz ko 1954 mein manzoori mili.

Lord Curzon ki intizami tabdeeli ke tehat Punjab ke trans-Indus zilon se 1901 mein NWFP banaya gaya. 2010 ki Atharhween Tarmeem ne Article 1 mein isi soobay ka naam Khyber Pakhtunkhwa kar diya; sooba banna aur naam badalna alag waqiat hain.

Maulana Sirajuddin Ahmad ne 1903 mein Lahore se haftawar Zamindar shuru kiya. Un ke baad bete Maulana Zafar Ali Khan ne akhbar sambhala aur usay siyasi sahafat ka moassar zariya banaya; bani aur baad ke mashhoor mudir alag shakhs hain.

Lord Curzon ke mansubay ke tehat Bengal ki pehli taqseem 16 October 1905 ko nafiz hui. Is taqseem ko wapas lene ka ailan 1911 ke Delhi Durbar mein hua; 1905 nafaz aur 1911 mansookhi ke ailan ka saal hai.

1906 mein Aga Khan III ki qiyadat wala Muslim wafd Simla mein Lord Minto se mila aur separate electorates ka mutalba kiya. Yeh alag intikhabi numaindagi 1909 ki Morley-Minto islaahat mein tasleem hui; wafd aur qanooni manzoori ke saal alag hain.

All-India Muslim League 30 December 1906 ko Dhaka mein Muslims ke siyasi huqooq ke tahaffuz ke liye qayam hui. Nawab Salimullah Khan ki all-India Muslim siyasi jamaat ki tajweez ne is qayam mein aham kirdar ada kiya; us waqt Viceroy Lord Minto thay.

Muslim League ka pehla baqaida salana ijlas 29–30 December 1907 ko Karachi mein Sir Adamjee Peerbhoy ki sadarat mein hua. Is se pehle 1906 mein Dhaka wali gathering League ke qayam ki meeting thi; founding meeting aur annual session ko alag samjhein.

Morley-Minto islaahat ka qanooni naam Indian Councils Act 1909 tha. Is ne markazi aur soobai legislative councils ko wasee kiya aur Muslims ke liye separate electorates ka bandobast tasleem kiya; aam naam aur qanooni naam aik hi islaahati qanoon ke hain.
Muslim League ka markazi daftar ibtida mein 1906 se Aligarh mein tha. 1910 mein woh Lucknow muntaqil hua; yeh jamaat ke qayam ka naya saal nahin, balke us ke daftar ki jagah badalne ka waqia hai.

Maulana Muhammad Ali Jauhar ne 1911 mein Calcutta se angrezi haftawar The Comrade shuru kiya aur us ki idarat bhi ki. Akhbar Muslim siyasi rai aur qaumi mabahis ko jagah deta tha; is ka naam, zaban aur ibtidai shehar isi sahafati kaam se jure hain.

King George V ne 12 December 1911 ko Delhi Durbar mein Bengal ki 1905 wali taqseem mansookh karne ka ailan kiya. Is entry ki tareekh shahanshahi ailan ki hai; pehli taqseem ka saal 1905 tha, 1911 nahin.

Maulana Abul Kalam Azad ne Calcutta se Urdu haftawar Al-Hilal jari kiya, jis ka pehla shumara 13 July 1912 ko nikla. Akhbar siyasi bedari aur azadi ke afkar ke liye jana gaya; yahan tareekh pehli ishaat ko zahir karti hai.

Muhammad Ali Jinnah ne 10 October 1913 ko All-India Muslim League ki baqaida rukniyat li. Yeh un ki party mein shamooliyat ka waqia hai; is tareekh ko jamaat ki bunyad ki tareekh samajhna mukhtalif dono waqiat ko mila deta hai.

Maulana Muhammad Ali Jauhar ne 1913 mein Delhi se Urdu roznamah Hamdard shuru kiya. Is ki ishaat siyasi aur qaumi shaour ke farogh ke liye thi; Hamdard ka Urdu roznamah hona aur Delhi se shuru hona is ki sahafati pehchan hain.

Islamia College Peshawar 1913 mein qayam hua aur usi saal dars-o-tadrees shuru hui. Quaid-e-Azam ne is ka 1936, 1945 aur azadi ke baad 1948 mein daura kiya; yeh teen dauray un ke idaray se taluq ko wazeh karte hain.

Iqbal ka pehla shaya-shuda shairi ka majmua Asrar-e-Khudi 1915 mein Farsi mein aaya. Yeh Farsi masnavi un ke falsafa-e-khudi ki bunyadi shairana peshkash hai aur baad mein mukhtalif zabanon mein tarjuma hui.

December 1916 mein Lucknow ke ijlasat ke dauran Congress aur Muslim League ne Lucknow Pact kiya. Is mein Muslim separate electorates barqarar rakhe gaye aur markazi legislature ke muntakhib Hindustani arkan mein Muslims ka aik-tehai hissa tasleem hua.

13 April 1919 ko Baisakhi ke din Amritsar ke Jallianwala Bagh mein jama nihattay logon par British fauj ne firing ki. Is qatl-e-aam ka shehar Amritsar aur jagah Jallianwala Bagh thi; dono naam aik hi sanehay ke maqam ko wazeh karte hain.

Rowlatt Act 1919 ne baghair muqadmay hirasat jaisay ghair-mamooli ikhtiyarat diye, jis par use Black Act kaha gaya. Muhammad Ali Jinnah ne isi qanoon ke khilaf ehtijajan Imperial Legislative Council se isteefa diya.

Government of India Act 1919 ki soobai dyarchy mein departments do qisamon mein batay thay. Aman-o-aman, police aur justice reserved thay aur governor ke control mein rehte thay; taleem jaisay transferred subjects waziron ke supurd thay.

Dina Wadia 15 August 1919 ko London mein paida hui thin. Un ki wafat 2017 mein New York City mein hui; London paidaish ka shehar aur New York wafat ka shehar hai, is liye dono ko zindagi ke alag marhalon se jorein.

Pehli All-India Khilafat Conference 23 November 1919 ko Delhi mein shuru hui. Agli yani doosri conference December 1919 mein Amritsar mein hui, jahan tehreek ke aainda laeha-e-amal par ghour hua; tarteeb Delhi phir Amritsar hai.

Jinnah ne Congress ke non-cooperation programme se usooli ikhtilaf kiya aur Nagpur session mein 28 December 1920 ko jamaat se alag hue. Yeh Congress se rukhsati ka waqia hai; is mein saal ke saath Nagpur aur ikhtilaf ki wajah bhi aham hain.

Hijrat Tehreek 1920 mein British India se Afghanistan ki taraf hijrat se mutalliq thi. Is mein Muslims ne bunyadi taur par Afghanistan ka rukh kiya; yeh naam us naqal-e-makani ki tehreek ka hai, kisi fauji jang ka nahin.

Indian Khilafat Deputation ne 1920 mein England ja kar British wazir-e-azam David Lloyd George ke samne apna mauqif rakha. Un se aham mulaqat March 1920 mein hui; yahan wafd ka daura aur mulaqat dono isi saal ke waqiat hain.

1921 ki Mappila ya Moplah baghawat Malabar ke kisan ilaqon mein colonial hukoomat aur zameeni nizam ki kashmakash mein uthi. Mappilas zyada tar Muslim baradari thi aur ibtidai marhala Khilafat Tehreek se bhi jura tha; Malabar aaj Kerala mein hai.

Muhammad Iqbal ki knighthood 1 January 1923 ke New Year honours ke ailan ke saath rasmi hui. Is ezaaz ke baad woh Sir Muhammad Iqbal kehlaye; yeh un ko milne wale khitab ki tareekh hai, kisi kitab ki ishaat ki nahin.
Payam-i-Mashriq Iqbal ki Farsi shairi ki kitab hai, jo May 1923 mein shaya hui. Is ka mashhoor angrezi tarjuma-e-unwan The Message of the East hai; dono naam aik hi kitab ko zahir karte hain.

Sir Fazl-i-Hussain ne 1923 mein Punjab Nationalist Unionist Party banai aur us ke pehle sadar bane. Jamaat Punjab ki zarai siyasat aur zameendar tabqon ka ittihad thi, jis mein Muslim, Hindu aur Sikh baradariyon ke afrad shamil thay.

John Marshall ne 1924 mein Indus Valley Civilization ki daryaft duniya ke samne pesh ki. Woh Archaeological Survey of India ke Director-General thay; 1924 is qadeem tehzeeb ke wajood ka aaghaz nahin, us ki jadeed daryaft ke ailan ka saal hai.

March 1927 mein Jinnah ki sadarat mein Muslim rehnumaon ne Delhi Muslim Proposals tay kiye. Yeh aaini samjhotay ki tajaveez thin; in mein Sindh ko Bombay Presidency se alag sooba banane ka mutalba bhi shamil tha.

1927 mein muqarrar hone wale Simon Commission se taawun par Muslim League mein ikhtilaf hua. Sir Muhammad Shafi ka giroh taawun ka haami tha, jabke Muhammad Ali Jinnah ka giroh mukhalif tha; yahan aik jamaat ke do siyasi mauqif samne aaye.

Sir John Simon ka commission 3 February 1928 ko Hindustan aaya, lekin koi Hindustani rukun na hone par bari siyasi jamaaton ne boycott kiya. Commission ki report baad mein 1930 mein do jildon mein shaya hui; aamad aur report ki tareekhein alag hain.

Motilal Nehru ki committee ne 1928 mein Hindustan ke liye aaini report tayyar ki aur British Commonwealth ke andar Dominion status tajweez kiya. Is mein Muslim tahaffuzat ke jawab mein Jinnah ne baad mein apne Fourteen Points pesh kiye.

Jinnah ke Fourteen Points 1929 mein Nehru Report ke jawab mein aaye. In mein Muslims ki aaini numaindagi, wafaqiyat aur soobai khud-mukhtari ke tahaffuzat wazeh kiye gaye; yeh alag alag mutalbat ko aik munazzam aaini mauqif banate thay.

December 1929 ke Lahore session mein Congress ne Purna Swaraj ko apna siyasi maqsad qarar diya. Purna Swaraj ka matlab mukammal azadi hai; Lahore, 1929 aur complete independence isi faislay ke teen pehlu hain.

Iqbal ne 29 December 1930 ko Allahabad mein Muslim League ka sadarti khutba diya. Unhon ne Punjab, Sarhad, Sindh aur Balochistan jaisay shumal-maghribi Muslim aksariyati ilaqon ko aik siyasi wahdat mein jorne ka tasawwur pesh kiya.

Ramsay MacDonald ki hukoomat ne Hindustan ke aaini mustaqbil par London mein 1930 se 1932 tak teen Round Table Conferences bulain. Pehli conference St James's Palace mein hui; B. R. Ambedkar aur Tej Bahadur Sapru teeno mein shareek thay.

Indian Statutory Commission ko us ke chairman Sir John Simon ki nisbat se Simon Commission kaha jata tha. Is ki report 1930 mein do jildon mein shaya hui aur bar-e-sagheer mein siyasi rad-e-amal paida hua; yahan saal report ki ishaat ka hai.

Allama Inayatullah Mashriqi ne 1931 mein Khaksar Tehreek ko munazzam karke qayam kiya. Khaksar Movement aur Khaksar Tehreek aik hi tanzeem ke angrezi aur Urdu naam hain; bani ka naam Mashriqi aur bunyad ka saal 1931 hai.

Maulana Muhammad Ali Jauhar 1931 mein Round Table Conference ke zamanay mein London mein wafat pa gaye. Un ki tadfeen Jerusalem mein Masjid-e-Aqsa ke ahatay ke qareeb hui; wafat London aur dafan Jerusalem mein hua.

Ramsay MacDonald ne August 1932 mein Communal Award ka ailan kiya. Yeh British India ki mukhtalif baradariyon ki intikhabi numaindagi ka bandobast tha aur depressed classes ke liye separate electorates bhi is mein shamil thay.

Indus River par Sukkur Barrage 1932 mein kaam karne laga aur Sindh ki nehri aabpashi ko wasee karne mein aham hua. Is ki yeh tareekh use Guddu aur Kotri se purana banati hai; barrage ka darya, umar aur aabpashi ka kirdar aapas mein jure hain.

Choudhry Rahmat Ali ne 1933 mein Cambridge se Now or Never pamphlet jari kiya, jis mein Pakistan ka naam pesh hua. Woh Cambridge ke Emmanuel College mein qanoon parh rahe thay; pamphlet, musannif aur un ka taleemi maqam aik hi waqiay se mutalliq hain.

1935 ke shadeed zalzalay ne Quetta aur gird-o-nawah ko wasee nuqsan pahunchaya. Is topic ka markaz shehar ki us qudrati aafat mein tabahi hai; yahan 1935 ko waqiay ke saal aur Quetta ko mutasir shehar ke taur par yaad rakhein.

Government of India Act 1935 ke tehat 1937 ke soobai intikhabat hue. Azadi par Pakistan ka apna mukammal aain tayyar nahin tha, is liye isi qanoon ko 1947 ki zaroori tabdeeliyon ke saath aboori dhancha banaya gaya; pehla baqaida Pakistani aain 1956 mein aaya.

Government of India Act 1935 ke nafazi intizam ke tehat Sindh 1 April 1936 ko Bombay Presidency se alag sooba bana. Yahan 1935 qanoon ka saal aur 1936 Sindh ki alag soobai haisiyat shuru hone ka saal hai.

1937 ke intikhabat Government of India Act 1935 ke tehat British India ke gyarah governor soobon mein hue. Is marhalay mein soobai dyarchy ki jagah muntakhib wazaraton ke saath provincial autonomy ka nizam amal mein aaya.

1937 ke Lucknow session mein Sir Sikandar Hayat Khan aur Muhammad Ali Jinnah ka siyasi samjhauta Sikandar-Jinnah Pact kehlaya. Sikandar Hayat us waqt muttahida Punjab ke Premier aur Unionist Party ke rehnuma thay.

Congress ki soobai wazaraton ke isteefon ke baad Muslim League ne 22 December 1939 ko Youm-e-Nijat manaya. Is din ka siyasi pas-e-manzar wazaraton ka khatma tha; tareekh ko us se pehle hone wale isteefon ke saath jor kar samjhein.

A. K. Fazlul Huq ne March 1940 ke Muslim League Lahore ijlas mein qarardad pesh ki, jis ki Sindh se Abdullah Haroon ne taeed ki. Asal matn mein Muslim aksariyati shumal-maghribi aur mashriqi ilaqon ke liye Independent States ki ibarat thi.

Viceroy Lord Linlithgow ne 8 August 1940 ko British hukoomat ki taraf se aaini peshkash ka ailan kiya. Doosri Jang-e-Azeem ke dauran aane wali isi peshkash ko August Offer kaha gaya; naam is ke mahine se jura hai.

Jinnah ne Muslim League ke mauqif ki tarjuman sahafat ke liye 1941 mein Delhi se haftawar Dawn shuru kiya; pehle editor Pothan Joseph thay. Is ki rozana ishaat 12 October 1942 ko shuru hui, is liye weekly aur daily ke aaghaz alag hain.
Abul A'la Maududi ne 1941 mein Jamaat-e-Islami ki bunyad rakhi. Is jamaat ki founding meeting Lahore mein hui; bani, saal aur shehar isi tanzeemi qayam ki pehchan hain.

British hukoomat ne Sir Stafford Cripps ko 1942 mein Hindustan ke aaini mustaqbil ki tajaveez de kar bheja. Un ki sarbarahi ki wajah se is koshish ko Cripps Mission kaha gaya; mission ka naam us ke sarbarah se nikla.

August 1942 mein Congress ne Gandhi ki qiyadat mein British iqtidar ke khatmay ke liye Quit India Tehreek shuru ki. Qarardad Bombay ke Gowalia Tank Maidan mein manzoor hui; isi jagah ko baad mein August Kranti Maidan kaha gaya.

Dawn ne 12 October 1942 ko Delhi se rozana akhbar ke taur par ishaat shuru ki. Baad mein akhbar Karachi muntaqil hua; Delhi ibtidai daily ishaat ka shehar hai, jabke Karachi us ke baad ke safar ka maqam hai.

Lord Wavell 1943 se 1947 tak Hindustan ke Viceroy rahe. Unhon ne Doosri Jang-e-Azeem ke aakhri barson mein ohda sambhala; 1947 mein Lord Mountbatten ne un ki jagah li, is liye Viceroys ki tarteeb Wavell phir Mountbatten hai.

C. Rajagopalachari ne Congress aur Muslim League ke darmiyan siyasi samjhotay ke liye C. R. Formula tayyar kiya. Yeh 1944 ki Gandhi-Jinnah baat-cheet mein zair-e-bahas aaya; C. R. isi tajweez dene wale rehnuma ke naam ka ikhtisar hai.

Lord Wavell ne 1945 ki Simla Conference apni Executive Council ki tashkeel-e-nau par ittefaq ke liye bulai. Jinnah chahte thay ke tamam Muslim arkan League nominate kare; Congress ke ikhtilaf ke saath numaindagi ka yeh masla deadlock ki wajah bana.

December 1945 ke Central Legislative Assembly intikhab mein Muslim League ne Muslims ke liye makhsoos tamam 30 nashistein jeetein. Yeh ginti sirf Muslim-reserved seats ki hai, poori markazi assembly ki tamam nashiston ki nahin.

1946 ka British Cabinet Mission teen arkan par mushtamil tha: Pethick-Lawrence, Stafford Cripps aur A. V. Alexander. Is wafd mein Cripps ki shirkat ko un ke naam se mashhoor doosray mission se alag samjhein; yahan poora teen-rukni Cabinet Mission murad hai.

April 1946 ke Delhi Convention mein Muslim League legislators ki qarardad Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy ne pesh ki. Is mein Lahore Resolution ki states wali ibarat se hat kar aik sovereign independent state ki wahid surat wazeh hui.

2 September 1946 ko Hindustan ki aboori hukoomat mein Jawaharlal Nehru Viceroy ki Executive Council ke Vice President bane. Unhon ne External Affairs ka portfolio bhi sambhala; is liye ohda aur mehkama do alag zimmedariyan thin.
Lord Mountbatten ne 24 March 1947 ko Lord Wavell ki jagah Viceroy ka ohda sambhala. Woh British India ke aakhri Viceroy thay aur taqseem tak is mansab par rahe; Wavell un se foran pehle thay.

Liaquat Ali Khan ne Hindustan ki aboori hukoomat mein Finance Member ke taur par 1947–48 ka Poor Man's Budget pesh kiya. Is budget ko samajhte waqt un ka us waqt ka Finance portfolio aham hai; yeh aboori Hindustani hukoomat ka budget tha.

Lord Mountbatten ne 3 June 1947 ko British India ki India aur Pakistan mein taqseem aur iqtidar ki muntaqili ka mansuba pesh kiya. 9 June ko Delhi mein Muslim League Council ne ghour karke Jinnah ko is ke bunyadi usool qabool karne ka ikhtiyar diya.

Pakistan ki pehli Constituent Assembly ka pehla ijlas 10 August 1947 ko Sindh Assembly Building, Karachi mein hua. Naya Pakistani aain abhi tayyar nahin tha, is liye azadi ke waqt 1935 ke qanoon ko zaroori tabdeeliyon ke saath aboori dhancha banaya gaya.

11 August 1947 ko Jinnah Pakistan ki pehli Constituent Assembly ke sadar muntakhib hue aur usi din pehla khitab kiya. Unhon ne rishwat aur corruption ko zehar qarar de kar khatam karne par zor diya; yahan sadarat assembly ki hai.

Azadi ke baad Karachi pehla wafaqi dar-ul-hukoomat tha; Liaquat Ali Khan pehle PM aur pehli federal cabinet ke sarbarah thay, jabke Jinnah Governor-General thay. Baad mein dar-ul-hukoomat ki tarteeb Karachi, aboori Rawalpindi aur phir Islamabad bani.

Sir Cyril Radcliffe 1947 mein Punjab aur Bengal ke Boundary Commissions ke chairman thay. Un ka tayyar karda sarhadi award 17 August 1947 ko aam hua, yani azadi ke baad; dono soobon ki nai hadbandi isi taqseemi amal ka hissa thi.

Pakistan 30 September 1947 ko United Nations ka rukun bana. General Assembly mein rukniyat ke haq mein 53 aur mukhalifat mein aik vote para; wahid mukhalif vote Afghanistan ka tha, lekin rukniyat manzoor ho gayi.

Bahawalpur ke hukmaran ne 7 October 1947 ko Pakistan ke saath Instrument of Accession par dastakhat kiye. Yeh dastavez riyasat ke Pakistan se ilhaq ka zariya thi; tareekh ilhaq ki dastavez par dastakhat ke waqiay se mutalliq hai.

Mirza Abol Hassan Ispahani, yani M. A. H. Ispahani, America mein Pakistan ke pehle safeer thay. Unhon ne 8 October 1947 ko Washington mein charge sambhala; yeh un ki sifarti muddat shuru hone ki tareekh hai.

Azad Jammu and Kashmir ki aboori hukoomat ka qayam 24 October 1947 se mansoob hai. Is ka dar-ul-hukoomat Muzaffarabad Jhelum aur Neelum daryaon ke sangam ke qareeb hai; tareekhi qayam aur dar-ul-hukoomat ki geography alag pehlu hain.

Taqseem ke baad 1947 mein Jammu and Kashmir ke tanazay par pehli India-Pakistan jang shuru hui, jise 1947–48 ki jang kaha jata hai. Is ke baad ceasefire ki nigrani ke liye January 1949 mein UNMOGIP ka kirdar shuru hua.

Pakistan Red Crescent Society 20 December 1947 ko insani khidmat ke liye qayam hui aur Jinnah is ke founding president thay. Is idaray ka kaam aafaat, sehat aur emergency relief se mutalliq hai, yani mushkil halaat mein insani madad.

Iran ne August 1947 mein Pakistan ko tasleem kiya aur dono mulkon ke sifarti taluqaat bhi 1947 mein qayam hue. Tasleem karna nayi riyasat ki haisiyat maanna hai, jabke diplomatic relations baqaida sifarti rabtay ka pehlu hain.

India ne 1 January 1948 ke khat ke zariye Jammu and Kashmir ki surat-e-haal Security Council mein pesh ki. UN Charter ka Article 35 rukun mulkon ko tanaza Council ya General Assembly tak lane ka rasta deta hai; Kashmir ceasefire ka observer mission UNMOGIP hai.

Jinnah ne State Bank of Pakistan ka baqaida iftitah 1 July 1948 ko kiya. Pehle governor Zahid Hussain ne 10 June 1948 ko ohda sambhala tha; governor ki taqarruri ka aaghaz aur central bank ka iftitah aik hi tareekh nahin.
Pakistan ka pehla Olympic wafd azadi ke baad 1948 ke London Games mein shareek hua. Is liye 1948 pehli Pakistani Olympic shirkat ka saal aur London un Games ka mezban shehar tha.

Teri Yaad 1948 mein azadi ke baad release hone wali pehli Pakistani feature film ke taur par jani jati hai. Us daur mein dastiyab studios ki wajah se ibtidai Pakistani cinema ka markaz Lahore tha, jahan film industry ka kaam jama hua.

Pakistan mein 1948 ka Development Board qaumi taraqqiyati mansuba-bandi ka ibtidai idara tha. 1953 mein is ki jagah Planning Board aaya aur baad mein Planning Commission bana; yeh aik hi planning nizam ke badalte idaray thay.

Liaquat Ali Khan ne Qarardad-e-Maqasid 7 March 1949 ko Constituent Assembly mein pesh ki. Is par bahs ke baad 12 March ko manzoori hui; is ne Pakistan ke aaini usool bayan kiye, aur pesh karna aur adopt karna paanch din ke faslay par hue.

Qarardad-e-Maqasid ko Pakistan ki Constituent Assembly ne 12 March 1949 ko manzoor kiya. Liaquat Ali Khan ne ise 7 March ko pesh kiya tha; yeh aaini usoolon ki qarardad thi aur manzoori us par bahs ke baad hui.

India aur Pakistan ne 27 July 1949 ko Karachi Agreement par dastakhat kiye. Is muahiday ne Jammu and Kashmir ki cease-fire line ki hadbandi aur nigrani ka tareeqa baqaida banaya; yahan bunyadi mauzu jang-bandi ki lakeer thi.

UNMOGIP ka poora naam United Nations Military Observer Group in India and Pakistan hai; yeh January 1949 mein qayam hua. Is ki ceasefire nigrani ka pas-e-manzar Kashmir par 1947 mein shuru hone wali pehli India-Pakistan jang thi.

PRODA, Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Act ka mukhtasar naam hai aur yeh 1949 ka qanoon tha. Is ka mauzu awaami aur numaindagi wale ohdon se na-ahli tha; acronym ko isi qanooni maqsad ke saath samjhein.

Liaquat Ali Khan aur Jawaharlal Nehru ne 8 April 1950 ko New Delhi mein Liaquat-Nehru Pact kiya. Is ne dono mulkon ki mazhabi aqalliyaton ki shehriyat, mazhabi azadi aur tahaffuz ke saath hijrat, jaidad aur bahali ke masail ko address kiya.

Azadi ke baad Pakistan ki pehli qaumi mardum-shumari 1951 mein hui. Is silsilay ki 2023 wali mardum-shumari saatween aur pehli mukammal digital census thi; ibtidai census aur digital marhalay ki tareekhein alag hain.
America aur Pakistan ka Point Four muahida technical cooperation, yani takneeki taawun, se mutalliq tha. Yeh 9 February 1951 ko nafiz hua; is entry mein tareekh muahiday ke amal mein aane ki hai.

1951 ka Rawalpindi Conspiracy Case Liaquat Ali Khan ki hukoomat ka takhta ulatne ki koshish se mutalliq tha. Major General Akbar Khan is sazish ka markazi fauji kirdar thay; nishana PM ki hukoomat aur aham fauji naam Akbar Khan tha.
Liaquat Ali Khan ko 16 October 1951 ko Rawalpindi ke Company Bagh mein jalsay se khitab ke dauran goli mari gayi. Pakistan ke pehle PM ki shahadat ke baad usi maqam ka naam Liaquat Bagh mashhoor hua.

Khawaja Nazimuddin ne October 1951 mein Liaquat Ali Khan ke baad Pakistan ke doosray PM ka ohda sambhala. Un ke baad 17 April 1953 ko Muhammad Ali Bogra aaye; tarteeb Liaquat, Nazimuddin, phir Bogra hai.
University of Karachi 1951 mein Karachi mein qayam hui. Yeh Pakistan ki bari sarkari jamiaat mein shamil hai; university ka naam us ke shehar se mansoob hai aur 1951 us ke qayam ka saal hai.

Pakistan Petroleum Limited ne 1952 mein Sui gas field daryaft ki, jis ne mulki tawanai mein aham kirdar ada kiya. Ise OGDCL se mansoob na karein: OGDCL baad mein 1961 mein qayam hui, jabke daryaft PPL ki thi.

Governor-General Ghulam Muhammad ne April 1953 mein Khawaja Nazimuddin ki hukoomat bar-taraf ki. Muhammad Ali Bogra ne 17 April 1953 ko teesray PM ke taur par ohda sambhala aur 11 August 1955 tak rahe; woh Nazimuddin ke janasheen thay.

Muhammad Ali Bogra ne 7 October 1953 ko Constituent Assembly mein Bogra Formula pesh kiya. Is ka aham pehlu yeh tha ke tajweez karda dono houses ke mushtarka ijlas mein East aur West Pakistan ko majmooi tor par barabar numaindagi mile.

Pakistan ka Development Board 1948 mein qayam hua aur 1953 mein us ki jagah Planning Board banaya gaya. Planning Board baad ke Planning Commission se pehle ka marhala tha; yeh tabdeeliyan qaumi mansuba-bandi ke idaray ki taraqqi dikhati hain.
Pakistan ke qaumi taranay ke alfaaz ko August 1954 mein rasmi manzoori mili. Alfaaz Hafeez Jalandhari ne likhe aur dhun A. G. Chagla ne banai; shair aur dhun banane wale ka kirdar alag hai.

Governor-General Ghulam Muhammad ne 24 October 1954 ko pehli Constituent Assembly tor di; us waqt PM Muhammad Ali Bogra thay. Assembly ke sadar Maulvi Tamizuddin Khan ne faisla Sindh Chief Court mein challenge kiya, jis se aaini-o-adalati tanaza ubhra.

Pakistan 1954 ke Manila Pact ke zariye SEATO ke bani arkan mein shamil hua. Manila Pact ka rasmi naam Southeast Asia Collective Defense Treaty tha; isi muahiday se Southeast Asia Treaty Organization bani.

East Bengal ke 1954 ke soobai intikhabat mein United Front ne hukmaran Muslim League ko shikast di. Awami Muslim League samait kai jamaatein United Front ke ittihad mein thin; winning alliance aur us ke andar ki jamaat ko alag pehchanein.

One Unit scheme ne 1955 mein maghribi hisay ke mukhtalif soobon aur riyasaton ko mila kar aik sooba West Pakistan banaya. Mushtaq Ahmad Gurmani is naye soobay ke pehle governor thay; One Unit intizami inzimam ka naam tha.

Chaudhry Muhammad Ali ne 1955 mein Muhammad Ali Bogra ke foran baad wazarat-e-uzma sambhali. Dono alag shakhs hain: Bogra pehle aur Chaudhry Muhammad Ali un ke janasheen thay; milte-julte naam ki wajah se tarteeb aham hai.

PIA ne 1955 mein qaumi airline ki baqaida surat ikhtiyar ki aur Orient Airways is ke nizam mein shamil hui. Usi saal Cairo aur Rome ke raste London ki pehli scheduled international service shuru hui; qayam aur international parwaz dono aham marhalay thay.

Kotri Barrage 1955 mein mukammal hua aur tareekhi tor par Ghulam Muhammad Barrage ke naam se bhi jana jata hai. Yeh Indus River par pani ki taqseem aur aabpashi ke liye hai; dono naam aik hi barrage ke hain.
Faiz Ahmad Faiz ko Rawalpindi Conspiracy Case mein giraftar karke muqadma chalaya gaya aur qaid hui. Woh 1955 mein riha hue; is entry ka saal rihai ka hai, case ke aaghaz ya un ki wafat ka nahin.
Pakistan ka pehla Five-Year Plan 1955 se 1960 ki taraqqiyati muddat ke liye tha. Is ke baad 1960 mein doosra plan shuru hua; 1960 pehle mansubay ka aakhri aur aglay mansubay ka shuruati saal tha.

Constituent Assembly ne pehla aain 29 February 1956 ko manzoor kiya aur woh 23 March 1956 ko nafiz hua. Is se Pakistan Islamic Republic bana; phir 7 October 1958 ko Iskander Mirza ne isi aain ko mansookh kiya.

23 March 1956 ko pehla aain nafiz hone par Pakistan Islamic Republic bana aur Governor-General ki jagah President ka ohda aaya; pehle President Iskander Mirza thay. Chaudhry Muhammad Ali PM thay, aur Article 214 ne Urdu aur Bengali ko state languages qarar diya.

Asghar Khan ne July 1957 mein PAF ki command sambhali aur pehle Pakistani Commander-in-Chief bane. Un ki command 1965 tak rahi, jis ke baad Air Marshal Nur Khan aaye; yeh daur 1957 se 1965 ke darmiyan tha.

WAPDA, Water and Power Development Authority, pani aur bijli ke wasail ki marboot taraqqi ke liye banai gayi. Is ka qanooni qayam 1958 ke Act XXXI ke zariye hua; saal aur act number isi bunyadi qanoon se mutalliq hain.

Pakistan ne 1958 mein Oman se Gwadar Feroz Khan Noon ki wazarat-e-uzma ke dauran hasil kiya. Is liye is waqiay mein Pakistan hasil karne wala mulk, Oman pehle ka ikhtiyar rakhne wala mulk aur Noon us waqt ke PM thay.

Iskander Mirza ne 7 October 1958 ko pehla mulk-geer martial law lagaya, assemblies torin aur 1956 ka aain mansookh kiya. Ayub Khan ko Chief Martial Law Administrator banaya gaya; ailan karne wale sadar aur CMLA ka ohda alag thay.

Ayub Khan ki hukoomat ne 1959 mein MLR-64 ke zariye bari zarai islaahat nafiz ki. Aam had aabpash zameen ke liye 500 acres aur ghair-aabpash zameen ke liye 1,000 acres thi; pani ki sahulat ke mutabiq ceiling badalti thi.

EBDO ka poora naam Elective Bodies (Disqualification) Order hai aur yeh 1959 mein jari hua. Is ka talluq elective bodies ki na-ahli ke hukm se tha; isay PRODA jaisay doosray siyasi qawaneen ke acronym se alag rakhein.

19 September 1960 ko Karachi mein Ayub Khan aur Jawaharlal Nehru ne World Bank ki madad se Indus Waters Treaty par dastakhat kiye. Maghribi darya Indus, Jhelum aur Chenab bunyadi tor par Pakistan ke liye, aur mashriqi Ravi, Beas aur Sutlej India ke liye muqarrar hue.

Pakistan ki pehli UN peacekeeping deployment 1960 mein Congo bheji gayi. Baad ki aman missions mein Haiti aur Sierra Leone samait doosray mulk bhi shamil rahe; Congo ko pehli deployment ke maqam ke taur par yaad rakhein.

President Ayub Khan ne 31 July 1960 ko Karachi mein Mazar-e-Quaid ka sang-e-bunyad rakha. Yeh Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah ka qaumi mazar hai; yahan tareekh imarat ke foundation-stone waqiay ki hai.
Warsak Hydroelectric Project ka pehla development phase 1960 mein mukammal hua. Yeh Kabul River par Peshawar ke qareeb Khyber Pakhtunkhwa mein hai; 1960 pehle marhalay ki takmeel ko zahir karta hai.

Pakistan ka doosra Five-Year Plan 1960 se 1965 ki muddat ko cover karta tha. Is se pehla plan 1955–1960 ka tha; dono ko musalsal paanch-paanch saala taraqqiyati mansubon ke taur par samjha ja sakta hai.

Choudhry Khaliquzzaman ki siyasi yaad-dasht Pathway to Pakistan pehli baar 1961 mein shaya hui. Kitab Tehreek-e-Pakistan aur Muslim League ke siyasi safar ko musannif ke zaati tajurbe ke hawalay se bayan karti hai.

Pakistan ka doosra aain 1 March 1962 ko jari hua, magar 8 June 1962 ko nafiz hua. Is ne sadarti hukoomat aur aik-aiwani federal legislature ka nizam diya; promulgation aur amal mein aane ki tareekh ko aik na samjhein.

8 June 1962 ko nafiz hone wale aain ne President ko markazi ikhtiyarat diye aur aik-aiwani legislature banai. Sadar ka intikhab barah-e-raast awam ke bajaye Basic Democrats par mushtamil electoral college karta tha.

Sir Muhammad Zafrulla Khan 1962 mein UN General Assembly ke sadar muntakhib hone wale pehle Pakistani bane. Unhon ne General Assembly ke satrahwein session ki sadarat ki; yeh ohda UN Secretary-General se mukhtalif hai.
Rawal Dam ki takmeel 1962 mein hui aur sarkari dam register mein is ka maqam Islamabad darj hai. Is topic mein 1962 takmeel ka saal hai; Islamabad ko dam ki jagah ke taur par us se jorein.

2 March 1963 ko China-Pakistan Boundary Agreement par Pakistan se Foreign Minister Zulfikar Ali Bhutto aur China se Chen Yi ne dastakhat kiye. Mutalliq ilaqay ki hatmi khud-mukhtari ka masla Kashmir dispute ke hal tak provisional rakha gaya.

Pakistan Television ki pehli transmission 26 November 1964 ko Lahore se shuru hui. Ibtida mein Lahore ke aarzi studio se nashriyat hui aur baad mein qaumi network bana; yeh aaghaz Lahore aur 1964 se mansoob hai.

Fatima Jinnah ne 1965 ke sadarti intikhab mein Ayub Khan ka muqabla kiya. Woh opposition ki mushtarka umeedwar thin; is liye yahan Fatima Jinnah ka kirdar sadarti umeedwar ka hai, ohda sambhalne ka nahin.

September 1965 ki India-Pakistan jang ki aam larai rokne wala ceasefire 23 September ko moassar hua. Pakistan ki sarkari riwayat 6 se 23 September ke is marhalay ko 17-roza jang kehti hai; Tashkent Declaration baad mein 10 January 1966 ko hua.
PAF ke bayan ke mutabiq M. M. Alam ne 7 September 1965 ko aik minute se kam mein paanch Indian tayyaray giraye. Woh F-86 Sabre ura rahe thay; yeh record PAF ke riwayati account se mansoob hai.

1965 ki jang ke baad Ayub Khan aur Lal Bahadur Shastri ne 10 January 1966 ko Soviet salisi mein Tashkent Declaration kiya. Maqsad jang ke baad taluqaat bahal karna tha; Tashkent aaj Uzbekistan ka dar-ul-hukoomat hai.

Sheikh Mujibur Rahman ne February 1966 mein Lahore ke siyasi ijlas ke mauqay par Six-Point Programme pesh kiya. Yeh Mashriqi Pakistan se mutalliq chhay siyasi mutalbat thay; Lahore peshkash ka shehar tha.

Asal Pakistan-China Karakoram Highway ki tameer 1966 se 1978 tak jari rahi. Pakistan aur China ne mil kar is road ko banaya; 1966 ka aaghaz aur 1978 ki takmeel aik hi asal project ki muddat ko zahir karte hain.
Madar-e-Millat Fatima Jinnah 9 July 1967 ko Karachi mein wafat pai. Un ki barsi 9 July ko hoti hai, jabke 31 July un ki paidaish ki tareekh hai; paidaish aur wafat ke din alag hain.

Friends Not Masters: A Political Autobiography Muhammad Ayub Khan ki siyasi khud-navisht hai. Oxford University Press ne isay 1967 mein shaya kiya; unwan ka Political Autobiography hissa kitab ki zaati siyasi yaad-dasht wali nauiyat batata hai.

Pakistan Was Inevitable Syed Hasan Riaz ki kitab hai aur us ki pehli ishaat 1967 ki hai. Yeh Tehreek-e-Pakistan ke tareekhi pas-e-manzar se mutalliq tasneef hai; kitab ke naam ko musannif aur pehli ishaat ke saal se jorein.

Quaid-i-Azam University 1967 mein University of Islamabad ke naam se qayam hui aur baad mein naya naam mila. Physicist Muhammad Raziuddin Siddiqui is ke pehle Vice-Chancellor thay aur unhon ne ibtidai ilmi-o-intizami qiyadat ki.

Pakistan Peoples Party ki founding convention 30 November 1967 ko Lahore mein hui. Is liye 1967 jamaat ki bunyad ka saal aur Lahore us meeting ka shehar hai; poori tareekh saal wale sawal ko mazeed wazeh karti hai.

Hukoomat ne 1968 mein Agartala Conspiracy Case qayam kiya, jis mein Sheikh Mujibur Rahman markazi siyasi mulzim thay. Awaami dabao ke baad February 1969 mein case wapas liya gaya aur Mujibur Rahman riha hue.
1962 ka aain 8 June 1962 se 25 March 1969 tak, yani taqreeban saat saal, nafiz raha. March 1969 mein is ka nizam khatam hua aur Yahya Khan ne sadarat sambhali; woh Pakistan ke teesray President thay.

Agartala Conspiracy Case 1968 mein Sheikh Mujibur Rahman aur doosray afrad ke khilaf shuru hua tha. Awaami dabao ke baad February 1969 mein ise wapas liya gaya aur Mujibur Rahman riha hue; 1968 aaghaz aur 1969 khatmay ka saal hai.

Pehli Islamic Summit 22–25 September 1969 ko Morocco ke dar-ul-hukoomat Rabat mein hui aur Pakistan ki qiyadat President Yahya Khan ne ki. Is ke faislon ne mustaqil Islamic Secretariat aur baad ke OIC dhanchae ki bunyad mein madad di.

1969 ke intizami regulation ne Swat, Dir aur Chitral ki sabiq riyasaton ki alag hukoomati haisiyat khatam karke unhein baqaida intizam mein shamil kiya. Chitral ka Pakistan se ilhaq 1947 mein ho chuka tha; ilhaq aur district wali haisiyat alag marhalay thay.

The Myth of Independence Zulfikar Ali Bhutto ki kitab hai, jo Oxford University Press se 1969 mein shaya hui. Is ka mauzu Pakistan ki foreign policy aur bari taqaton ke saath taluqaat hai; yeh musannif ka siyasi aur sifarti tajziya pesh karti hai.

Pakistan ke pehle President Iskander Mirza 1969 mein London mein wafat pa gaye. Un ka jasad-e-khaki Iran le jaya gaya aur Tehran mein sarkari aizaz ke saath dafan hua; wafat aur tadfeen ke shehar alag thay.

One Unit ke khatmay ke baad 1 July 1970 ko Balochistan ko mukammal alag soobai haisiyat mili. Quetta is ka dar-ul-hukoomat tha; yeh waqia naye soobai intizam se mutalliq hai, shehar ke qayam se nahin.

Pakistan ke pehle barah-e-raast aam intikhabat 1970 mein hue; National Assembly ki polling 7 December ko hui. Mashriqi Pakistan mein Sheikh Mujibur Rahman ki qiyadat wali Awami League ne bari fatah hasil ki; qaumi aur soobai polling ki tareekhein alag thin.

Pakistan Army ne 25 March 1971 ki raat Mashriqi Pakistan mein Operation Searchlight shuru kiya. Yeh fauji crackdown aglay din tak wasee karwai mein badal gaya; entry mein March ka mahina aur 25 March ki raat aaghaz ko zahir karte hain.

Pakistan ne 1971 mein pehla Men's Hockey World Cup jeeta. Tournament Spain ke shehar Barcelona mein hua tha; pehla edition, mezban shehar aur Pakistani championship isi aik sporting waqiay ke pehlu hain.

1971 mein Pakistan ne America aur China ke darmiyan khufiya rabtay mein darmiyani kirdar ada kiya. American official Henry Kissinger Pakistan ke raste khufiya Beijing safar par gaye; yeh US-China sifarti qurbat ka aham marhala tha.

Noorul Amin 7 se 20 December 1971 tak Pakistan ke PM rahe, yani taqreeban 13 din. Un ka yeh mukhtasar daur us waqt ke siyasi aur jangi bohran mein aaya; shuru aur aakhri tareekh dono December ki hain.

Zulfikar Ali Bhutto ne 20 December 1971 ko Yahya Khan ke baad President aur Chief Martial Law Administrator ke ohday sambhale. Woh pehle civilian CMLA thay; yeh un ki sadarat ka marhala hai, wazarat-e-uzma se mukhtalif.

Pakistan ne 30 January 1972 ko Commonwealth chhorne ka ailan kiya. Woh 1989 mein dobara rukun bana; rukhsati aur wapsi ko do alag marhalon ke taur par samjhein, na ke 1972 ko mustaqil aakhri rukniyat ka saal.

Bhutto hukoomat ka bara qaumiyane ka programme 1972 mein shuru hua. January ke ibtidai sanati marhalay mein chuninda idaron ka management liya gaya, foran ownership nahin; baad ki nationalization aur phir privatization ko is ibtidai qadam se alag samjhein.

1971 ki jang ke baad Bhutto aur Indira Gandhi ne 2 July 1972 ko Simla Agreement kiya. Is mein Kashmir ki ceasefire line ko Line of Control ke taur par tasleem kiya gaya; Bhutto ne us waqt President ki haisiyat se dastakhat kiye.

Sindh ke 1972 language law ne Sindhi ko soobay ki aik rasmi zaban qarar de kar taleem, farogh aur sarkari istemal ki bunyad di. Baad mein 1991 mein Sindhi Language Authority tahqeeq aur zaban ke farogh ke liye qayam hui.

14 August 1973 ko nafiz aain ne wafaqi parliamentary hukoomat aur National Assembly-Senate par mushtamil do-aiwani Parliament di. Article 2 Islam ko state religion qarar deta hai; Article 2A ka talluq Qarardad-e-Maqasid se hai, dono alag shiqein hain.
Zulfikar Ali Bhutto August 1973 se July 1977 tak Pakistan ke PM rahe. National Assembly ki rasmi chronological ginti mein woh nauwein PM hain; yahan 1973–1977 un ki wazarat-e-uzma ka daur hai.
Pakistan ke pehle Senate ke qayam ke baad Habibullah Khan 1973 mein us ke pehle chairman muntakhib hue. Is liye un ka naam naye Senate ki ibtidai qiyadat se jura hai; ohda Senate Chairman ka tha.

Begum Ra'ana Liaquat Ali Khan 15 February 1973 ko Sindh ki governor muqarrar hui thin. Woh is soobay ki governorship sambhalne wali pehli khatoon thin; pehli-khatoon ka ezaaz isi makhsoos ohday ke hawalay se hai.

Pakistan Steel Mills ka sang-e-bunyad 30 December 1973 ko rakha gaya. Yeh project ka tameeri aaghaz zahir karne wala marhala tha; is tareekh ko production shuru hone ya mills ki takmeel ki tareekh na samjhein.

Pakistan 1973 mein SEATO se rasmi taur par alag hua, lekin tanzeem foran band nahin hui. Baqi arkan ki dilchaspi aur amli kirdar kam hone ke baad SEATO 1977 mein dissolve hui; Pakistani exit aur tanzeem ke khatmay mein farq hai.

Doosri Islamic Summit 22–24 February 1974 ko Lahore mein hui. Saudi Arab ke King Faisal bhi is mein shareek hue; 1974 ka saal, February ka mahina aur Lahore ka shehar isi doosray summit ko pehchante hain.

Bangladesh, India aur Pakistan ka Tripartite Agreement 9 April 1974 ko hua. Pakistan ki taraf se Aziz Ahmed aur Bangladesh ki taraf se Kamal Hossain ne dastakhat kiye; yeh teen mulkon ka muahida tha, sirf do-fareeqi pact nahin.

Sabiq President Muhammad Ayub Khan 19 April 1974 ko Islamabad ke qareeb wafat pa gaye. Un ki wafat sadarat chhorne ke taqreeban paanch saal baad hui; yeh tareekh zindagi ke ikhtitam ki hai, sadarti muddat ke khatmay ki nahin.

Aala difaai tashkeel-e-nau ke tehat Chairman Joint Chiefs of Staff Committee ka ohda March 1976 mein qayam hua. General Muhammad Shariff is ke pehle chairman muqarrar hue; institution ke aaghaz aur pehli taqarruri isi saal se jure hain.

Pakistan National Alliance ne 1977 ke intikhabi nataij mustarad karke Bhutto hukoomat ke khilaf ehtijaj kiya. Is ke markazi mutalbat naye intikhabat aur Bhutto ka isteefa thay; PNA ka mauqif election results ke tanazay se nikla.

General Zia-ul-Haq 1977 mein Chief of Army Staff thay jab unhon ne hukoomat ka takhta ulat kar martial law lagaya. Baad mein un ki sadarat ke daur mein 1980 ka Zakat and Ushr Ordinance jari hua; dono un ke daur ke alag marhalay hain.

Asal Karakoram Highway ki tameer Pakistan aur China ke engineers aur karkunon ne 1966 se 1978 tak ki. Highway Khunjerab Pass ke raste dono mulkon ko zameeni rabta deti hai; 1978 is asal tameeri muddat ka aakhri saal hai.

Pakistan 1979 mein Non-Aligned Movement ka baqaida rukun bana. CENTO se us ki wabastagi bhi 1979 mein tanzeem ke khatmay ke saath khatam hui; difaai ittihadi wabastagiyon ke baad ghair-wabasta tehreek mein shirkat naya marhala tha.

Abdus Salam ne 1979 ka Physics Nobel Sheldon Glashow aur Steven Weinberg ke saath share kiya. Un ki electroweak theory ne electromagnetic aur weak interactions ko aik framework mein jora; Nobel ka field Physics aur bunyadi kaam yahi wahdat thi.

If I Am Assassinated Zulfikar Ali Bhutto ki tasneef hai aur pehli baar 1979 mein shaya hui. Is entry ka saal kitab ki ishaat ko zahir karta hai; unwan aur musannif ko isi bibliographic pehchan ke saath samjhein.

Federal Shariat Court 28 May 1980 ko qayam hui. Article 203D use qawaneen ya un ki shiqon ka Quran-o-Sunnat ke ahkam se muqabla karke Islami mutabiqat jaanchne ka ikhtiyar deta hai; yeh is adalat ka makhsoos aaini kirdar hai.

Zakat and Ushr Ordinance 1980 mein President Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq ke daur mein jari hua. Is se pehle 1977 ke martial law ke waqt woh Chief of Army Staff thay; qanoon ki ishaat aur fauji takeover alag saalon ke waqiat hain.

Lahore Fort aur Shalamar Gardens 1981 mein mil kar UNESCO World Heritage List mein aik mushtarka entry bane. Yeh Mughal tameer aur baghbani ki misalein hain; Lahore Fort ki bari Mughal tameer Akbar ke daur ki hai, jabke baad ke badshahon ne mazeed izafay kiye.

Makli, Thatta ke qareeb Sindh ka wasee tareekhi qabristan, yani necropolis, hai. Yahan kai sadiyon ke maqbaray aur tadfeeni tameer ki yaadgarein hain; UNESCO ne is maqam ko 1981 mein World Heritage List mein shamil kiya.

Qaumi taranay ke alfaaz likhne wale Hafeez Jalandhari 14 January 1900 ko Jalandhar mein paida hue. Un ki wafat 21 December 1982 ko Lahore mein hui; paidaish aur wafat ke shehar un ki zindagi ke alag siray hain.

Siachen par musalsal fauji muqabla 1984 se mansoob hai, jab India ne 13 April ko Operation Meghdoot shuru kiya. Is operation ka maqsad glacier ke aham maqamat hasil karna tha aur is ke baad taweel fauji maujoodgi ka daur shuru hua.

Kashmiri rehnuma Maqbool Butt ko 11 February 1984 ko Tihar Jail mein phansi di gayi. Is topic ki tareekh un ki saza-e-maut par amal ka din hai; 1984 saal, February mahina aur Tihar maqam ko zahir karte hain.

1985 ke qaumi aur soobai intikhabat ghair-jamaati bunyad par hue. National Assembly ki polling 25 February aur soobai assemblies ki 28 February ko hui; dono intikhabat aik saal mein thay magar polling ke din alag thay.

1985 ki Aathween Tarmeem ne Revival Order aur mutalliq iqdamaat ko aaini tahaffuz diya, jis ka record Article 270A mein hai. Usi aaini bandobast mein Article 58(2)(b) ke tehat President ko makhsoos halaat mein National Assembly torne ka ikhtiyar mila.
Muhammad Khan Junejo ki wazarat-e-uzma 29 May 1988 ko khatam hui. Yahan tareekh un ke Prime Minister ke ohday ke ikhtitam ko zahir karti hai, kisi sadarti mansab ya un ki wafat ko nahin.

Zia-ul-Haq 17 August 1988 ko Bahawalpur ke qareeb tayyaray ke hadsay mein wafat pa gaye. Senate Chairman Ghulam Ishaq Khan ne qaim-maqam sadarat sambhali aur December 1988 mein baqaida President muntakhib hue.

Benazir Bhutto ne aam intikhabat ke baad December 1988 mein pehli baar wazarat-e-uzma sambhali. Woh Muslim-aksariyati mulk ki pehli muntakhib khatoon sarbarah-e-hukoomat thin; yeh ezaaz PM ke hukoomati kirdar ke hawalay se hai.
Pakistan ne 30 January 1972 ko Commonwealth chhorne ka ailan kiya tha aur 1989 mein dobara rukun bana. Is topic mein 1989 wapsi ka saal hai; pehli rukhsati ki tareekh ko is se alag rakhein.
First Women Bank Limited ne 1989 mein Pakistan mein karobar shuru kiya. Is ka bunyadi maqsad khawateen ki maali shamooliyat, karobar aur maashi khud-mukhtari ke liye banking sahulat dena tha.

Pressler Amendment American Foreign Assistance Act ki aik sharait wali shiq thi. 1990 mein zaroori sadarti tasdeeq na hone par Pakistan ke liye American fauji imdad ruk gayi; is liye pabandiyan lagane wala mulk United States tha.

1991 ka Water Apportionment Accord Pakistan ke charon soobon ke darmiyan hua. Is ka mauzu Indus River system ke dastiyab pani ki bain-us-soobai taqseem tha; yeh Pakistan-India muahida nahin, mulk ke andar soobon ka bandobast hai.

Hukoomat-e-Sindh ne 1991 mein Sindhi Language Authority zaban ki tahqeeq, taleem, farogh aur durust sarkari istemal ke liye banai. Is se pehle 1972 ka language law Sindhi ke soobai rasmi istemal ki qanooni bunyad de chuka tha.

1991 ke Water Apportionment Accord mein soobon ke pani ki taqseem ka bandobast hua. Is ke nafaz ke liye IRSA, yani Indus River System Authority, 1992 ke Act XXII ke tehat bani; pehle accord aur aglay saal authority aayi.

Pakistan ne 1992 ke Men's Cricket World Cup final mein England ko hara kar title jeeta. Final Melbourne Cricket Ground mein khela gaya; England muqabil team thi aur Melbourne Cricket Ground match ka venue tha.

All Parties Hurriyat Conference 9 March 1993 ko 26 siyasi, samaji aur mazhabi tanzeemon ke ittihad ke taur par bani. Isay aik umbrella organization samjhein: mukhtalif giroh aik mushtarka platform mein jama hue thay.
Farooq Ahmad Leghari ki sadarat 14 November 1993 ko shuru hui aur 2 December 1997 ko khatam hui. Un ke baad Wasim Sajjad ne aarzi qaim-maqam sadarat sambhali; Leghari ki baqaida muddat 1993–1997 thi.
Pakistan ka pehla women's police station 25 January 1994 ko Islamabad mein khola gaya. Is topic mein Islamabad iftitah ka shehar hai aur 1994 is pehle station ke aaghaz ka saal.

Lady Health Workers Programme 1994 mein Family Planning aur Primary Health Care ke qaumi programme ke taur par shuru hua. Har worker apne ilaqay ke taqreeban 1,000 afrad ko ghar aur community ki satah par bunyadi sehat ki khidmaat deti hai.

Muhammad Yousaf ne 1994 mein Pakistan ki numaindagi karte hue IBSF World Amateur Snooker Championship jeeti. Yeh world amateur snooker ka title tha; khilari ka naam aur Pakistan ki numaindagi isi sporting kamyabi ko wazeh karte hain.

Pakistan 1 January 1995 se World Trade Organization ka rukun hai. WTO ke qayam ke din se rukniyat ki wajah se Pakistan founding members mein shamil hai; yeh tijarati tanzeem ki rukniyat ka aaghaz hai.

Farooq Leghari ki November 1993 se jari sadarat 2 December 1997 ko khatam hui. Wasim Sajjad 2 December se 1 January 1998 tak qaim-maqam President rahe, phir Rafiq Tarar aaye; aarzi aur baqaida sadarat alag marhalay hain.

Pakistan ne 28 May 1998 ko Balochistan ke Chagai mein pehle elaniya nuclear tests kiye. Isi waqiay ki yaad mein 28 May ko Youm-e-Takbeer manaya jata hai; isay 6 September ke Youm-e-Difa se alag rakhein.

Pakistan ki paanchween Population and Housing Census 1998 mein hui. Agli yani chhatti census 2017 mein hui; dono ko mulki mardum-o-khana-shumari ki tarteeb mein paanchween aur chhatti ke taur par jorein.

PM Nawaz Sharif aur Indian PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee ne 21 February 1999 ko Lahore Declaration par dastakhat kiye. Yeh Lahore mein hua do-fareeqi ailan tha; dastakhat karne wale dono us waqt apne mulkon ke wazir-e-azam thay.
Kargil conflict 1999 mein India aur Pakistan ke darmiyan hua. Larai Jammu and Kashmir mein Line of Control ke qareeb buland pahari ilaqay mein thi; is liye boundary ka hawala LoC hai.

Havildar Lalak Jan 7 July 1999 ko Kargil ke mohaaz par larte hue shaheed hue. Un ki ghair-mamooli bahaduri par Nishan-e-Haider diya gaya; shahadat ki tareekh aur ezaaz dono Kargil conflict se jure hain.

12 October 1999 ke fauji takeover ke waqiat ke waqt Army Chief Pervez Musharraf Sri Lanka ke dauray se wapas aa rahe thay. Is waqiay mein Sri Lanka safar ka mulk aur Musharraf us waqt ke fauji sarbarah thay.

Pervez Musharraf ne 1999 mein Chief Executive ki haisiyat se iqtidar liya, lekin President 20 June 2001 ko bane. Dono ohdon ka aaghaz aik nahin; sadarti muddat ke sawal mein 2001 aur Chief Executive ke liye 1999 relevant hai.

11 September 2001 ke hamlon ke baad Pakistan ne international anti-terrorism coalition ki himayat ka faisla kiya. Us waqt President Pervez Musharraf thay aur un ki hukoomat ne America aur aalami ittihad ke saath taawun kiya.

30 April 2002 ko hone wale referendum mein Pervez Musharraf ki sadarat mazeed paanch saal jari rakhne ki himayat maangi gayi. Is liye tareekh voting ki aur five years tajweez karda izafi sadarti muddat ki miqdaar hai.

Mir Zafarullah Khan Jamali ne November 2002 mein PM ka ohda sambhala aur 26 June 2004 ko isteefa diya. Un ka PM daur 2002–2004 tha; baad mein un ki wafat 2 December 2020 ko hui, jo ohda chhorne se mukhtalif waqia hai.

Rubab Raza Olympic swimming mein Pakistan ki numaindagi karne wali pehli khatoon banin. Unhon ne Athens 2004 ke women's 50 metres freestyle event mein hissa liya; ezaaz Olympic swimming ki pehli shirkat ka hai.
Shaukat Aziz August 2004 se November 2007 tak Pakistan ke PM rahe. Is se pehle woh Finance Minister thay; un ke siyasi safar mein pehle maali portfolio aur phir wazarat-e-uzma ka marhala aata hai.
Srinagar-Muzaffarabad bus service ka rasmi aaghaz 7 April 2005 ko hua. Yeh cross-LoC service dono shehron ko milati hai; yahan tareekh bus service ke formal launch ki hai.

8 October 2005 ko taqreeban 7.6 moment magnitude ka zalzala Kashmir aur sabiq NWFP mein aaya. Is ne shumali Pakistan mein wasee tabahi ki; 7.6 zalzalay ki quwwat ka andaza hai, mutasir afrad ya ilaqon ki ginti nahin.

Benazir Bhutto aur Nawaz Sharif ne 14 May 2006 ko London mein Charter of Democracy par dastakhat kiye. Isay Meesaq-e-Jamhuriyat bhi kaha jata hai; dono naam isi siyasi-jamhuri muahiday ko zahir karte hain.

Pervez Musharraf ne muakhazay ke dabao ke dauran 18 August 2008 ko sadarat se isteefa diya. Unhon ne fauji iqtidar 1999 mein sambhala tha aur baad mein President bane; 2008 un ki sadarat ke ikhtitam ka waqia hai.

Pakistan ne disability rights ke UN convention par 25 September 2008 ko dastakhat kiye. Ratification 5 July 2011 ko hui; dastakhat ibtidai razamandi thay, jabke ratification se Pakistan qanooni tor par convention ka fareeq bana.

Gilgit-Baltistan Empowerment and Self-Governance Order 2009 ne ilaqay ke qanoon-saz aur intizami dhanchae ko nai surat di. GB Assembly ki 33 nashistein 24 general, 6 khawateen aur 3 technocrat/professional seats par mushtamil hain.

May 2009 mein aman bandobast nakaam hone ke baad Swat aur wasee Malakand ilaqay mein Rah-e-Rast shuru hua. Maqsad riyasati amal-dari bahal karna tha; is ke baad South Waziristan ki karwai Rah-e-Nijat ke naam se hui.

Operation Rah-e-Nijat 2009 mein South Waziristan ke shiddat-pasand thikanon ke khilaf tha. Is se pehle May 2009 mein Swat-Malakand ki karwai Rah-e-Rast thi; milte-julte naam hone ke bawajood bunyadi ilaqay alag thay.

Easypaisa ne 2009 mein mobile phone aur agent network ke zariye branchless banking shuru ki. Isay Pakistan ki pehli mobile-money service ke taur par record kiya jata hai; service ka nizam sirf riwayati bank branch par mabni nahin tha.

Atharhween Tarmeem 2010 ne kai ikhtiyarat wafaq se soobon ko de kar soobai khud-mukhtari barhai aur parliamentary nizam mazboot kiya. President ke assembly torne jaisay ikhtiyarat mehdood hue aur Article 1 mein NWFP ka naam Khyber Pakhtunkhwa hua.

July–August 2010 ke sailabon se Pakistan ke kul raqbay ka taqreeban aik-paanchwan hissa mutasir hua. Aik-paanchwan hissa 20 feesad ke barabar hai; dono izhar isi andazay ke hain aur yeh raqbay ka hissa hai, abadi ka nahin.

Pakistan ne disability rights convention par 25 September 2008 ko dastakhat kiye aur 5 July 2011 ko ratify kiya. Ratification rasmi qanooni tasdeeq thi, jis se mulk convention ka fareeq bana; pehle dastakhat aur baad ki tasdeeq alag marahil hain.

Pakistan: A Personal History Imran Khan ki kitab hai, jis ki pehli ishaat 2011 mein hui. Yeh zaati aur siyasi yaad-dasht ko Pakistan ki tareekh ke saath jorti hai; kitab ka mauzu sirf musannif ki khelon ki zindagi nahin.

Punjab Food Authority ko Punjab Food Authority Act 2011 ne qanooni bunyad aur ikhtiyarat diye. Is ki bunyadi zimmedari khanay ki safety, quality aur mutalliq qawaid ka nafaz hai; 2011 authority ke bunyadi qanoon ka saal hai.

Chaudhry Pervaiz Elahi June 2012 se March 2013 tak Deputy Prime Minister rahe. Yeh muddat Raja Pervaiz Ashraf ki hukoomat mein thi; PM Raja Pervaiz Ashraf aur deputy Chaudhry Pervaiz Elahi alag shakhs aur ohday thay.

Ayesha Farooq ne 2013 mein final combat qualification hasil karke Pakistan ki pehli combat-ready khatoon fighter pilot ka ezaaz hasil kiya. Yeh pehchan fauji larai ke liye qualify karne ki hai, har qisam ki pehli khatoon pilot hone ka daawa nahin.

Pakistan-China Economic Corridor Secretariat ka iftitah 27 August 2013 ko Islamabad mein hua. CPEC ki bunyadi raahdari Xinjiang ko Gwadar Port se jorti hai; Gwadar is ka aham junoobi samundari endpoint hai.
Operation Zarb-e-Azb 15 June 2014 ko North Waziristan mein shuru hua. Is waqiay ko tareekh aur launch ilaqay ke saath jorein: yahan North Waziristan murad hai, South Waziristan ya Swat nahin.

National Action Plan 24 December 2014 ko manzoor hua aur dahshat-gardi aur inteha-pasandi ke khilaf 20-nukati policy dhancha tha. Is liye 20 nuqaat ki tadaad hai, jabke 24 December is ki manzoori ki tareekh hai.

December 2014 ke Army Public School hamlay ke baad January 2015 ki Ikkeesween Tarmeem ne muayyan terrorism cases ke liye military courts ki gunjaish di. Ibtidai intizam do saal ki mehdood muddat ka tha, mustaqil ghair-mehdood bandobast nahin.

Xi Jinping ka do-roza Pakistan daura 20 April 2015 ko shuru hua aur 51 agreements aur MoUs par dastakhat hue. Is waqt CPEC ka ibtidai elaniya project portfolio taqreeban US$46 billion tha; yeh us daur ka figure hai, har baad ke project ka final majmooa nahin.

Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act, yani PECA, 2016 mein Act XL of 2016 ke taur par bana. Yeh electronic jurm aur un se mutalliq investigation ka bunyadi wafaqi qanoon tha; XL us ka rasmi act number hai.

Pakistan Navy ne December 2016 mein Task Force 88 Gwadar Port aur mutalliq sea lanes ki hifazat ke liye banai. Is ke wasail mein ships, fast attack craft, aircraft, drones aur surveillance assets shamil thay; drones baghair pilot hawai nigrani mein madad dete hain.

Operation Radd-ul-Fasaad 22 February 2017 ko mulk bhar mein shuru kiya gaya. Yeh nationwide counterterrorism karwai thi, is liye is ka daira kisi aik agency ya sirf aik shehar tak mehdood nahin bataya jata.

Pakistan Bureau of Statistics ne 2017 mein chhatti Population and Housing Census ki. Is se pehle paanchween census 1998 mein hui thi; 1998 aur 2017 ko mardum-o-khana-shumari ki musalsal tarteeb mein samjhein.
Dr Ruth Pfau ne Pakistan mein jazam ke mareezon ke liye dahaiyon tak khidmat ki aur 10 August 2017 ko wafat pai. Un ki qaumi khidmaat ke aitraf mein Karachi mein state funeral diya gaya.

Dina Wadia 15 August 1919 ko London mein paida hui thin aur 2017 mein New York City mein wafat pai. Is liye London un ki paidaish ka shehar hai, jabke New York un ki zindagi ke ikhtitam se mansoob hai.

Punjab Women Protection Authority 2017 ke soobai Act ke tehat qayam hui. Qanoon ne khawateen ke tahaffuz ke iqdamaat ko marboot karne ke liye is idaray ki bunyad aur ikhtiyarat diye; authority aur us ka act aik hi naam se jure hain.

National Assembly ne 24 May 2018 ko FATA-Khyber Pakhtunkhwa merger ka aaini bill pass kiya. Pacheesween Tarmeem ne sabiq FATA ki alag wafaqi haisiyat khatam karke KP mein inzimam diya; Assembly ka vote qanooni amal ka aik marhala tha.

25 July 2018 ko 1970 se ginay jane wale Pakistan ke gyarawein aam intikhabat hue. ECP ne isi election mein polling-station nataij ki electronic muntaqili ke liye nationwide Result Transmission System, yani RTS, pehli baar lagaya.

Imran Khan ne 18 August 2018 ko Pakistan ke 22wein PM ke taur par halaf liya. President Mamnoon Hussain ne un se halaf liya; yahan halaf lene wale PM aur halaf dilane wale President ke kirdar alag hain.

Mamnoon Hussain ki 2013–2018 ki muddat ke baad Arif Alvi ne 9 September 2018 ko sadarat sambhali. Arif Alvi Pakistan ke terhwein President thay; succession ki tarteeb Mamnoon Hussain se Arif Alvi ki taraf hai.

Justice Tahira Safdar ne 1 September 2018 ko Balochistan High Court ki Chief Justice ka halaf liya. Woh Pakistan ki kisi bhi High Court ki pehli khatoon Chief Justice thin; ezaaz High Court ke is sarbarahi ohday ka hai.

Krishna Kumari Kohli 2018 mein Pakistan ki pehli Hindu Dalit khatoon senator banin. Woh Sindh ki reserved seat par PPP ke ticket se muntakhib hui thin; un ka sooba, jamaat aur parliamentary ezaaz isi intikhab se jure hain.

Kartarpur Corridor November 2019 mein Guru Nanak ki 550ween paidaishi salgirah ke mauqay par khola gaya. Is ka maqsad sarhad paar yatriyon ki Gurdwara Darbar Sahib Kartarpur tak rasai asan banana tha.

Asad Qaiser ne 4 October 2019 ko National Assembly ki Common Man's Gallery ka iftitah kiya. Woh us waqt National Assembly ke Speaker thay; gallery ka maqsad aam shehriyon ki parliamentary rasai behtar karna tha.

National Security Committee ne 13 March 2020 ko COVID-19 ke sabab mulk-geer hifazati bandishon ka faisla sunaya. Taleemi idaray ibtida mein 5 April 2020 tak band karne ka hukm tha; yeh pehli muqarrar muddat thi, tamam pandemic bandishon ki hatmi muddat nahin.

Wafaqi cabinet ki manzoori ke baad Imran Khan ne 4 August 2020 ko Pakistan ka naya siyasi naqsha pesh kiya. Is mein Kashmir se mutalliq hukoomati mauqif bhi shamil tha; yeh rasmi siyasi map ki ishaat ka waqia hai.
Mir Zafarullah Khan Jamali 2 December 2020 ko wafat pa gaye. Woh 2002–2004 ke dauran PM thay aur 26 June 2004 ko isteefa de chuke thay; 2020 wafat ka saal hai, wazarat-e-uzma khatam hone ka nahin.

2023 ki mardum-shumari Pakistan ki saatween qaumi census aur pehli mukammal digital census thi. Azadi ke baad pehli census 1951 mein hui thi; digital marhala puranay census silsilay ki saatween kadi tha.

Pakistan ka PRSC-EO1 electro-optical satellite 17 January 2025 ko China ke Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center se bheja gaya. Launch ke liye Long March-2D rocket istemal hua; satellite Pakistani tha jabke launch center China mein tha.

President ne 13 November 2025 ko Sattaisween Aaini Tarmeem ki manzoori di, jis se yeh Act ki surat mein nafiz hui. Is tarmeem ne Federal Constitutional Court qayam karke use makhsoos aaini daira-e-ikhtiyar diya.
